checks.label: Microphone Mute
checks.description: Hardware microphone mute status
checks.remediation: Toggle microphone mute via quick settings or Settings > Sound > Microphone.

checks.label: Camera Mute
checks.description: Hardware camera mute status
checks.remediation: Toggle camera mute via quick settings or Settings > Privacy > Camera access.

checks.label: Voice Recording Apps
checks.description: Apps using audio recording
checks.remediation: Revoke microphone permission for untrusted apps in Settings > Apps > Permissions.

checks.label: Clipboard Access Notification
checks.description: Should notify when apps access clipboard
checks.remediation: Enable clipboard access alerts in Settings > Privacy > Show clipboard access.

checks.label: Clipboard Service
checks.description: Clipboard service status
checks.remediation: Clear clipboard regularly and avoid copying sensitive data like passwords.

checks.label: Screen Brightness Mode
checks.description: Auto-brightness status
checks.remediation: Review brightness settings in Settings > Display > Brightness level.

checks.label: Adaptive Brightness
checks.description: Adaptive brightness setting
checks.remediation: Adjust adaptive brightness in Settings > Display > Adaptive brightness.

checks.label: Always On Display
checks.description: Always on display may show sensitive info
checks.remediation: Disable always-on display in Settings > Display > Lock screen > Always on display.

checks.label: Screen Capture Disabled (Device Policy)
checks.command: D=$(dumpsys device_policy 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'screen ?capture ?disabled|mScreenCaptureDisabled' | head -3); [ -z "$D" ] && echo NO_POLICY || echo "$D"
checks.description: Reports whether a device/profile owner has disabled screen capture (screenshots and screen recording) via DevicePolicyManager.setScreenCaptureDisabled. On a managed kiosk, POS, medical or BYOD-work-profile device that handles sensitive on-screen data, screen capture should be disabled by policy so content cannot be exfiltrated via screenshots or screen recording. NO_POLICY means no admin has set the restriction (screenshots are allowed), which is the stock default and reported as INFO rather than a failure, since it is only a finding on devices that are meant to be locked down. This replaces an earlier check that mistakenly read the unrelated screensaver_enabled setting.
checks.remediation: On a managed device, have the DPC call DevicePolicyManager.setScreenCaptureDisabled(admin, true). This blocks screenshots, screen recording and non-system screen sharing for the affected user/profile. There is no stock user-facing toggle; it requires a device or profile owner.

checks.label: Location Services Mode
checks.description: Location services mode (0=off, 3=high accuracy)
checks.remediation: Disable location or reduce accuracy in Settings > Location > Location services.

checks.label: GPS Enabled
checks.description: Allowed location providers
checks.remediation: Remove unnecessary location providers in Settings > Location.

checks.label: Location History
checks.description: Location history can be privacy concern
checks.remediation: Disable location history in Settings > Location > Location services > Google Location History.

checks.label: Network Location Provider
checks.description: Network-based location opt-in status
checks.remediation: Opt out of network location in Settings > Location > Location services.

checks.label: Notification Listeners
checks.description: Notification listeners can read all notifications including OTPs
checks.remediation: Remove untrusted notification listeners in Settings > Apps > Special access > Notification access.

checks.label: Notification Policy Access
checks.description: Apps with notification policy access
checks.remediation: Review apps with notification policy access in Settings > Apps > Special access.

checks.label: Lock Screen Notifications
checks.description: Private notifications on lock screen
checks.remediation: Hide sensitive notifications on lock screen in Settings > Notifications > Lock screen.

checks.label: Heads Up Notifications
checks.description: Heads up notification display
checks.remediation: Disable heads-up notifications in Settings > Notifications if they reveal sensitive content.

checks.label: Screen Lock Enabled
checks.description: Device should have PIN/Password/Pattern lock enabled
checks.remediation: Set a PIN, password, or pattern in Settings > Security > Screen lock immediately.

checks.label: Lock Screen Timeout
checks.description: Screen timeout should be 30 seconds or less for security
checks.remediation: Reduce screen timeout to 30 seconds or less in Settings > Display > Screen timeout.

checks.label: Show Passwords Disabled
checks.description: Passwords should not be shown when typing
checks.remediation: Disable show passwords in Settings > Privacy > Show passwords.

checks.label: Lock Screen Notification Visibility
checks.description: Sensitive notifications should be hidden on lock screen
checks.remediation: Set lock screen notifications to "Hide sensitive content" in Settings > Notifications.

checks.label: Smart Lock Disabled
checks.description: Smart Lock may reduce security by keeping device unlocked
checks.remediation: Disable Smart Lock in Settings > Security > Smart Lock to prevent bypass.

checks.label: Sensors Privacy Mode
checks.description: Sensor privacy mode status
checks.remediation: Enable sensor privacy mode via quick settings tile to block sensor access.

checks.label: Step Counter
checks.description: Step counter sensor status
checks.remediation: Revoke body sensor permissions from apps that do not need step data.

checks.label: Active Sensors
checks.description: Currently active sensors
checks.remediation: Review and close apps using sensors unnecessarily, or enable sensors-off toggle.

checks.label: Screen Lock
checks.command: dumpsys window policy 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'showing.*lock\|isShowing' || dumpsys trust 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'enabled' || settings get secure lockscreen.password_type 2>/dev/null
checks.description: Screen lock status (multiple detection methods)
checks.remediation: Ensure a screen lock is active in Settings > Security > Screen lock.

checks.label: Clipboard Access
checks.description: Check if clipboard has sensitive data
checks.remediation: Clear the clipboard after copying sensitive data to prevent leaks.

checks.label: Clipboard History
checks.description: Clipboard history should be disabled to prevent data leaks
checks.remediation: Disable clipboard history in your keyboard settings or use a clipboard manager with auto-clear.

checks.label: Fingerprint / Setup Complete
checks.description: Check if device setup is complete
checks.remediation: Complete device setup wizard to ensure all security features are configured.

checks.label: Trust Agents Enabled
checks.description: May allow unlock bypass via smart lock
checks.remediation: Disable trust agents in Settings > Security > Smart Lock to prevent unlock bypass.

checks.label: Microphone Usage
checks.description: Detects open microphones
checks.remediation: Close apps actively using the microphone, or revoke mic permissions for untrusted apps.

checks.label: Camera Usage
checks.description: Detects active camera clients
checks.remediation: Close apps actively using the camera, or revoke camera permissions for untrusted apps.

checks.label: Sensors in Use
checks.description: Shows currently used sensors
checks.remediation: Close unnecessary apps using sensors, or enable the sensors-off quick settings tile.

checks.label: Network Telemetry
checks.description: Should be disabled unless required
checks.remediation: Disable usage reporting in Settings > Privacy > Usage and diagnostics.

checks.label: Sensitive Data in Logs
checks.description: Sensitive data found in system logs
checks.remediation: Clear logs with 'logcat -c' and fix apps that log sensitive data in plaintext.

checks.label: Backup Files on Device
checks.description: Backup files may contain sensitive data
checks.remediation: Delete unnecessary backup files or move them to encrypted storage.

checks.label: Log Files Accessible
checks.description: Log files may contain sensitive information
checks.remediation: Remove unnecessary log files and restrict log directory permissions.

checks.label: Cleartext Storage Check
checks.description: SharedPreferences directories - may store data in cleartext
checks.remediation: Use EncryptedSharedPreferences or Android Keystore for sensitive data.

checks.label: Location Data Stored
checks.command: find /data -type f -name '*.db' -exec sqlite3 {} "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name LIKE '%location%' OR name LIKE '%gps%';" \; 2>/dev/null | head -5
checks.description: Location tracking databases
checks.remediation: Delete location databases from unused apps and disable location history.

checks.label: Database Files Present
checks.description: Database files count - may contain PHI, verify encryption
checks.remediation: Ensure databases are encrypted with SQLCipher or equivalent. Audit for PHI.

checks.label: Backup Files Present
checks.description: Backup files may contain unencrypted PHI
checks.remediation: Delete unencrypted backup and export files, or encrypt them before storing.

checks.label: Restricted Settings Enabled (Android 13+)
checks.description: Android 13 introduces Restricted Settings: when a sideloaded app tries to enable Accessibility, Notification Listener, Device Admin, or BindVpnService, Android blocks the toggle and shows a 'Restricted setting' dialog. Setting should be 1.
checks.remediation: Ensure enhanced_confirmation_mode is 1. On Android 13+ this is on by default; if changed, restore it.
